value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks mostly partly sunny, with a high around 65 (other forecasts have 64 to 67). Winds are north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph, turning east to northeast in the afternoon, with gusts up to 17 mph. Rain may move in Tuesday evening: the weather service gives about a 30% chance after 3 pm, and AccuWeather has rain chances above 40% from 8 PM into the early morning, while 9NEWS has them at 24% at 8 PM and 35% at 11 PM. Overnight lows are in the 30s to low 40s with rain at times.
